name: Patrick M. Wensing
title: Wanzek Family Foundation Collegiate Professor of Engineering; lab biography lists Associate Professor
fitReason: Multi-Loco (CoRL2025 per official lab publication list) combines a morphology-agnostic diffusion policy and shared RL residual for heterogeneous legged robots. This is a specific modern robot-learning connection alongside the lab’s broader optimization and assistive-control research.

physicalEvidence.summary: The primary Multi-Loco paper documents real deployment on point-foot biped, wheeled biped, humanoid and quadruped platforms, controlled at50Hz through EtherCAT on an Intel i9 CPU. Appendix Go2 unseen-platform transfer is simulation and is not added as another demonstrated real robot.

shortVisit.summary: The current join page describes graduate-school admission and undergraduate research, with an old2024–25 undergraduate pause. It gives no current external short-term master’s route; the old pause is not interpreted as a summer2027 prohibition.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct generative cross-embodiment policy and residual-RL fit.
scoreReasons.physical: Four physical embodiments are verified in an international collaboration, not a Notre Dame-local hardware inventory.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No current external short-visit invitation; degree recruiting not scored.
scoreReasons.freshness: Inspected dated primary hardware evidence is from June 2025; current role verification alone does not establish new 2026 research.

name: Xiaonan (Sean) Huang
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: RoboCrafter-QA studies whether a fine-tuned foundation model can select and generate functional soft-robot designs. The RoboSoft2026 conference program confirms the recent project; the primary study includes physical design verification rather than only a simulator benchmark.

physicalEvidence.summary: The author paper fabricates LLM-generated modular5x5 voxel robots from soft/rigid elastomers, magnets and pneumatic actuators, then compares their real forward motion. This supports embodied design learning; it does not show an LLM directly executing a closed-loop manipulation policy.

shortVisit.summary: No external short-term master’s visitor invitation was verified. The lab contact page returned little searchable text and a repeated Cloudflare verification page in the cloud browser, so it is not treated as a successfully reviewed recruitment page.

scoreReasons.fit: Concrete foundation-model embodied design, with specialized soft-robot emphasis.
scoreReasons.physical: Fabricated LLM-generated designs and comparative locomotion, not direct VLA manipulation deployment.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Visitor terms remain unverified, including blocked contact page.
scoreReasons.freshness: RoboSoft2026 confirmation and September2026 activity, primary physical report late2025.

name: Yanran Ding
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: SurGE (IROS 2026 per current lab news) combines a PPO-trained design-aware control policy with differentiable surrogate dynamics and evolutionary optimization of compliant legged robots.

physicalEvidence.summary: The primary June2026 paper tests three physically adjusted MUPS-v2 hopper designs. A learned policy runs at50Hz on an external workstation and commands the real robot through an onboard Raspberry Pi, with encoders and IMU for state estimation.

shortVisit.summary: Current lab, faculty and project pages verify active research but no explicit external short-term master’s invitation was found. Current graduate members are mentoring precedent, not availability.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct neural policy/co-design fit, more specialized than broad manipulation or VLA.
scoreReasons.physical: Explicit physical MUPS-v2 deployment of learned control, with architecture and experiment details.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No external summer visitor pathway verified.
scoreReasons.freshness: June2026 primary hardware study and September2026 active lab.
